name: AttachmentTile
label: Attachment tile
description: One file as a square: a picture, a coloured mark for well-known formats, or a neutral badge, with upload states.

props.name: name
props.description: File name, extension included. Truncates in the middle so the extension stays visible.

props.name: kind
props.description:
What kind of file it is, which picks the type mark: a coloured lettered
glyph for the well-known formats, a neutral extension badge for the
rest. Derive it with `getFileKind`.

props.name: typeLabel
props.description: Short uppercase label on the type mark. Defaults from the kind and the extension.

props.name: status
props.description: Where the file is in its life. Anything but `ready` shows the name with a status line.

props.name: progress
props.description: Upload progress, 0 to 100, reported to assistive technology while `uploading`.

props.name: previewSrc
props.description:
Image that fills the tile while `ready`: an object URL for a picture, or
a first page the host rendered for a document. A non-image kind keeps
its type mark over the corner.

props.name: previewAlt
props.description: Alt text for the preview. Defaults to the file name.

props.name: previewMark
props.description:
Whether the type mark sits over the corner of a preview. Defaults to on
for a document's first page, which still has to say what format it is,
and off for a picture, which is its own description. A sent message
turns it on for pictures too.

props.name: excerpt
props.description: First lines of a pasted block, drawn as a faded excerpt filling the tile while `ready`.

props.name: meta
props.description: Secondary line under the name while `ready`, e.g. "1.2 MB". Callers keep their own formatting.

props.name: error
props.description: Why the file failed. Replaces `errorLabel` on the status line.

props.name: size
props.description:
Tile size. Compact shrinks the square and drops the secondary line of a
ready file. Unrelated to any native `size` attribute: the root is a div.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Its presence makes the tile body a button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Remove handler. Its presence renders the corner remove button.

props.name: uploadingLabel
props.description: Status line while `uploading`.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Status line while `error`, when no `error` message is given.

props.name: unavailableLabel
props.description: Status line while `unavailable`.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the remove button. Defaults to "Remove" and the file name.

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the upload progress spinner while `uploading`, given the file name. Defaults to "Uploading" followed by the name.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
